headline: Climate Investment Yields 15-Fold Return, New UN Study Shows
meta_description: A UN assessment reveals that $1 invested in proven climate and clean air measures generates $15 in economic benefits while preventing 144 million premature dea…
summary_short: New UN research shows climate action isn't a cost—it's a bargain. Every dollar spent on proven measures returns $15 in economic gains.
body:
A new UN assessment has found that investing $1 in 25 proven climate and clean air measures could generate around $15 in economic benefits while preventing an estimated 144 million premature deaths by 2050.

The study reframes climate action from an expense to an investment. The 25 measures span renewable energy adoption, emissions reduction, and air quality improvements—interventions with track records of success.

What makes this finding significant is the scale of dual impact: economic returns don't come at the expense of human welfare. Instead, the same investments that strengthen economies also spare hundreds of millions of lives from the health costs of pollution and climate-related harm. The research suggests that the barriers to climate action are often political and structural rather than financial.

25 proven climate and clean air measures assessed by UN
144 million premature deaths could be prevented by 2050
